translation: Took place in posad Serock, 2[2/6?] May 1890, 7 PM. Appeared personally Jankiel Borensztejn, carpenter, 36, and Berek Koltun, attendant of the Jewish cemetery, 65, both residing in Serock, and declared that this day at 5 AM died in posad Serock a child of female sex named Laja Rozental, aged half a year, daughter of Berek and Masza[?], the Rozental spouses, shoemakers residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
